title: Authorization: RBAC, permissions, ownership, tenant isolation, optional Cedar
objective: Authorizer abstraction (deny by default) with RBAC role->permission mapping, resource ownership, organisation membership checks, system-admin trust level separate from organisation roles, MFA-required checks; type-level org scoping for repositories; optional Cedar engine passing the same test suite.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant A user cannot read/modify Tenant B resources at API and repository layers (tests)
Org admin cannot reach /admin APIs; role changes cannot self-escalate (tests)
Cedar engine (feature) passes the shared authorization conformance suite
